newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar steady in range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar steady in range-bound trade.

text.p: Indian sugar prices were steady in range-bound trade on Thursday, dealers said.
They said a recent strike by transport operators disrupted both arrivals and dispatches.
"However as the truckers have now called off their strike we are expecting fresh flow of sugar from mills to the market," one dealer said.
In ready delivery prices were 1,350/1,400 rupees per quintal for the S-30 variety and 1,425/1,450 rupees per quintal for the M-30 variety.
"These are however only nominal rates as there is not much trading in ready delivery due to shortage of ready stock and absence of fresh arrivals," another dealer said.
Sugar mill delivery dropped to 1,210/1,230 rupees per quintal from 1,215/1,240 rupees on higher offerings by mills, dealers said.
"Now that the supply situation in the ready delivery is likely to improve as the truckers' strike is withdrawn, prices may come down," a dealer said.
